'''Akarrin Comeris''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]], who has allied herself with the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]]{{ref/book|6|40}}. 

==Appearance==
She is slim, with quick eyes. She has a plain brown wool dress, and a cloak with surprisingly elaborate green embroidery. {{ref/book|10|19}} She nodded for emphasis with almost every other word.

==Abilities==
Akarrin is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very weak]] in the [[One Power]], with a strength level of {{opsl|40}}. Egwene thinks that "Akarrin was not strong in the Power, little more than Siuan if at all".{{ref/book|10|19}} In fact, this is marginally above [[Siuan Sanche]]'s strength after she was healed from [[Stilling|Severing]]. 

She is an expert in [[talent|reading residues]].{{ref/book|10|19}}

== History ==
Akarrin is 199 years old. She was born in {{ne|801}} and went to the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|816}}. After eleven years as a [[novice]] and ten as [[Accepted]] she was raised to the shawl in [[837 NE]].

She taught [[Moiraine]] and [[Siuan]] when they were novices and Accepted.

==Activities==
She is sent to where the huge amount of ''[[saidar]]'' was detected during what was then unknown but will eventually be called the [[Cleansing of saidin|Cleansing of ''saidin'']]. She reports to the [[Rebel Hall of the Tower]] of an enormous hole with huge amounts of ''[[saidin]]'' residues. {{ref/book|10|19}} This news is the impetus for the [[Black Tower Alliance|alliance]] of the [[White Tower]] and the [[Black Tower]].

== Errata ==
The [[The Wheel of Time Companion|Wheel of Time Companion]] says she was raised to the shawl in {{ne|829}}, but this is not possible given her birth date, enrollment and training times. Rather than assume an error in the other figures, we adjust the date above to {{ne|837}}.
